name: defect-foreign-logo
about: The trailer carries a red emblem and the name ACME Logistics, which the kit lists as a forbidden mark.

no_malformed_people_or_vehicles.reason: The truck and trailer appear physically plausible with normal wheel count, axle placement, and no merged or distorted parts visible.

people_policy_met.reason: People are not allowed per policy. No person or recognisable body part is visible anywhere in the image, including cab windows.
